results.market_title: Will Yandy Díaz lead the 2026 MLB Postseason in RBI?
results.reasoning: Yandy Díaz has gone 0-for-12 AB with zero RBI through the Rays' ALDS sweep of the Yankees, putting him well behind the pace needed to lead the entire 2026 postseason in RBI. While the Rays have advanced to the ALCS (and could reach the World Series, giving Díaz up to ~14 more games), he is not a prototypical power/RBI hitter (22 HR, more of a table-setter/contact bat) and is already trailing likely leaders who have driven in runs in the Division Series round. His chances of overtaking the field to finish as the sole or tied postseason RBI leader are low.
results.key_findings: ["MLB.com: Díaz is 3-for-12 (.250 AVG) with 0 RBI through the ALDS vs Yankees (Rays swept in 3 games)","Rays (98-64, AL East #1 seed) advanced to ALCS vs Cleveland Guardians starting 10/12","Díaz's regular season profile (22 HR, 85 RBI) shows solid but not elite power output relative to postseason RBI contenders","Fox Sports/ESPN confirm Rays are alive deep into October, giving Díaz additional games, but he starts the ALCS with zero postseason RBI banked"]

results.market_title: Will the lowest temperature in Warsaw be 2°C on October 12?
results.reasoning: Multiple forecast sources (AccuWeather, timeanddate.com, The Weather Network) for Warsaw on Oct 12, 2026 show overnight/morning lows clustering around 4-6\u00b0C, consistent with October climate normals (mid-month average low ~5.9\u00b0C). A reading as low as 2\u00b0C would require a notably colder night than currently forecast across sources, making it possible but unlikely.

results.market_title: Will the lowest temperature in Munich be 0°C on October 13?
results.reasoning: Multiple forecast sources (AccuWeather 10-day, climate normals) show overnight lows for Munich around 10-13 October 2026 in the 5-11°C range, well above the 0°C bracket. Since the event is only about a day out, short-range forecasts are fairly reliable, and even accounting for the airport station (EDDM) typically running a few degrees cooler than the city center due to radiative cooling in open terrain, a drop all the way to 0°C would require an unusual deviation from the forecast.

results.market_title: US x Iran ceasefire continues through October 31?
results.reasoning: The US-Iran ceasefire (following the June 2025 'Operation Midnight Hammer' strikes and the broader Israel-Iran war) has held for over a year without a qualifying US air or missile strike on Iranian territory. Absent any credible, verified reporting of a new US strike in the lead-up to or during October 2026, the base rate strongly favors continuation, consistent with prior months' resolutions of similar rolling ceasefire markets resolving YES. I was unable to access live web search in this session to confirm the very latest October 2026 developments, so some uncertainty remains around any recent escalation not reflected in my training data.
results.key_findings: ["Ceasefire between US/Israel and Iran has been in place since mid-2025 after the 12-day war and US strikes on Iranian nuclear sites","No qualifying US air/missile strike on Iranian territory has been publicly confirmed as of the last available information","Market resolution requires a specific overt US air or surface-to-surface missile strike directly impacting Iranian territory, a high bar not met by lower-level incidents","Crowd price of 79% implies meaningful perceived tail risk, likely reflecting ongoing regional tensions (Iran nuclear program disputes, proxy conflicts) but still favors continuation"]
